THE LAW BETWEEN PAGES

Connected does not mean combined.

TIME

Age, memory, sequence, knowledge, and consequence matter. The coordinates are not a simple past-and-future ladder.

CROSSING

People, evidence, objects, histories, and questions may intersect without merging each world’s native rules.

THE THRESHOLD

MARY leads narratively toward the WHO-era story. Cosmologically, 6_66 and 66_6 remain distinct realities.

PAGE I · LEVEL 6, FOLD 66

Mary

A scholar enters the mystery carrying books, stubbornness, and the conviction that every monster can still be explained.

AGE 18BLOODLINES · 12/12RIDGEFALL

Mary begins Bloodlines as an eighteen-year-old scholarship student, Ridgefall City Library worker, orphan, and dedicated monster-and-folklore nerd. The supernatural is still scholarship to her—until physical evidence appears that she cannot classify.

Folklore is testimony here, not automatic proof. Belief, skepticism, scholarship, and rumor remain knowledge states until the story earns an answer.

PAGE II · LEVEL 66, FOLD 6

Count
Wrongula

Smug, elegant, theatrical—and moving through a supernatural reality whose crossings have begun to fail.

WHO · 12/12SUPERNATURAL NATIVECROSSING CRISIS

No humans naturally exist in 66_6. For roughly three months before the end of WHO, crossing restrictions tighten and species-specific food becomes scarce and expensive. Wrongula has never crossed planes, while his ordinary-food household remains an unexplained anomaly.

He casts a reflection, walks in sunlight, drinks no blood, and prefers ordinary prepared food, coffee, and tea. The reason he differs from vampire norms remains open.
